_about: Garment style catalogue for auto-onboarding (M-14). Keyed by the BASE style code; InkSoft store SKUs add a store suffix (PC55BCAT -> PC55, 8800MACCCW -> 8800), so the longest matching prefix wins. Names follow what staff write on hand-filled onboardings, NOT InkSoft's product names (INK-24). vendor = 'Vendors Used' on the form. kind = the form's required 'Garment Kind' (E-74), one of GARMENT_KINDS in the form's src/placements.js.
